newsitem.title: GERMANY: Hellmann forms Polish freight forwarding offshoot.
newsitem.headline: Hellmann forms Polish freight forwarding offshoot.

text.p: German freight forwarder Gebrueder Hellmann GmbH & Co KG said it has formed a Polish joint venture to expand its eastern Europe presence.
Hellmann said it will hold a 60 percent share and its partner Robert Moritz will have a 40 percent stake in Hellmann Moritz International Forwarders.
The new company will be responsible for import and export of air and sea freight, European overland transport and storage and distribution within Poland.
Robert Moritz, one of Poland's largest freight companies with 200 staff and five offices, was already a member of the Hellmann worldwide partnership group.
Hellmann general manager Karl Mohnsen said: "Growth in the eastern European market and the significance of the location led to the decision to strengthen our partnership.
"Poland is developing increasingly into a hub for east-west connections," he added.
